name: North walk (lobby to rimstone)
purpose: A roofed 4 m stair that climbs from the lobby to the terrace shelf: low roof, ankle lanterns, a runnel of warm water coming down beside you - the compression before the rimstone reveal.

ceiling_profile.note: Timber-and-rock roofed gallery under the vault: roof 3.0 m above the treads all the way up (-64.0 at the lobby, -58.5 at the top landing).

floor_note: The floor is north_walk_stair: 32 risers of 0.1719 from -67.0 at the lobby to -61.5 at the shelf, 3 runs / 2 landings, 3 m wide over the plan (66,66)-(70,70)-(78,70). Spine z below is linear along the plan.

portals.note: The whole passage is this stair.

hero.why: The gallery's only opening, cut in the south wall at the lower landing: it frames the steaming teal terraces lit from outside, so it is the brightest thing in a dim stair and pulls you up and round the corner.

anchored.why: Handrails on both sides, on the treads.
Roofed timber gallery (3 m over the treads), built from passage frames since the shell has none: the compression before the reveal.

water.note: Stone runnel at the north wall foot, stepping down beside the treads in 0.17 m drops; from the top tier feed to the lobby basin.

sightlines.see: Up the stair: the teal window glowing at the landing, the runnel glinting.
Out onto the shelf: the terraces fall away below - the reveal.

concept.match: No B3 concept for this passage; borrow 05's mood: low dark gallery, warm niche lanterns at ankle height doubled in the runnel, one bright opening ahead.

lights.why: Small ankle lanterns on the treads, alternating sides: lit and dark in turn.
Cold teal light behind the window: the brightest thing in the climb.

mood.key: dim climb toward a teal window
mood.palette: amber ankle light, dark timber roof, teal from outside
mood.mist: steam drifts in from the top end

allow_overlap_why: Passage frames meet at the turn; the window is cut through the passage's south wall.
